title: Reproduction materials: Three-group variance-ratio tests for heteroscedasticity in linear regression
description:
Code and per-replication results for the paper Three-group variance-ratio tests for heteroscedasticity in linear regression: an exact null distribution and an outlier-resistant version (A. El-Kotory and E. K. Ebrahim).

The observations are sorted by any chosen variable and split into three equal parts; the regression is fitted separately in each part, and the statistic is the ratio of the largest to the smallest error scale. With least squares fits (KaH-III) the ratio follows Hartley's maximum F distribution exactly; with least trimmed squares fits (KaH-robust) it resists outliers.

Contents. simulations/: every script, in the order it was run, with the p-value of every test in every replication: the exact null distribution checks, the effective degrees of freedom of the LTS scale, size and power of the proposed and competing tests, the factorial comparison over variance shape, ordering variable, dimension, contamination and sample size, the study with heavy-tailed errors, the power curves, the robust Goldfeld–Quandt study and the data examples. KOTORY/: the R package, as a Git submodule pinned to version 0.1.0. README.md maps every table and figure of the paper to the scripts and files that produce it.

Code is MIT-licensed; stored results are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE).
